facts.value: Students enrolled in other departments can complete certain modules at our Department of Economics, known as export modules, which also include optional modules. This is only possible based on existing cooperation agreements between departments.
facts.programme_association: Fundamental Courses - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: For the study programs of other departments, an overview is provided which export modules can be registered at the Department of Economics and how these export modules can be integrated into the student's study program in their department. Furthermore, no other modules from the Department of Economics can be integrated into the study program of another department, nor can different credit points (CP) be obtained at the Department of Economics.
